visual.summary: L2 plus a drill corner with a straw dummy, target and bench on the east side, a lamp post, vines and a campfire on the chimney; a clear step up.
problems: Straw dummy carved_pumpkin at (9,2,4) faces west into the house wall one block away; turn it to facing=east so it faces the yard/bench.
Drill corner is squeezed into the 2-block strip x9..10 against the wall; it reads as a pile of props. Spread it out (fence the yard, keep the target opposite the dummy) if the footprint allows.
Campfire on the chimney top (3,8,11) sits at ridge height and reads as an odd orange lump in the iso; fine if the chimney is raised a block as asked for L1.
Flat side walls and one-tone roof as in L1.
Reachability: fine; only roof slopes are unreached, every room (mess room, bed loft) is reached.
